name: omnimeet/jitsi
description: Omnimeet Jitsi: a video meeting on a Jitsi Meet instance - one's own, a public one, or 8x8's Jitsi as a Service - embedded through the IFrame API and driven from the page, a JSON Web Token per participant (shared secret or key pair), several people, JaaS webhooks read and their signature checked.

suggest.ext-openssl: Tokens signed with a private key (RS256): Jitsi as a Service, or an instance that validates against a public key server
